description: Return a bounded one-based term of Hofstadter's Q sequence.

source.title: A005185: Hofstadter Q-sequence
source.author: OEIS Foundation Inc.; sequence introduced by Douglas R. Hofstadter
source.publication: OEIS A005185; Hofstadter, Gödel, Escher, Bach, p. 138
source.independent_method_source: Nathan Fox, A New Approach to the Hofstadter Q-Recurrence, Journal of Integer Sequences 20 (2017), Article 17.7.3
source.source_license: References consulted for the mathematical recurrence and published values only; all implementations are clean-room.

workspace.meaning: Bounded 129-element signed integer recurrence table with alignment margin.

contract.indexing: one-based; the input index n selects Q(n).
contract.definedness: Only the published finite prefix through index 128 is claimed. If an evaluated dependency is outside 1..i-1, return -1; no statement is made about all positive indices.
contract.primary_method: Fill Q values in increasing index order.
contract.independent_method: Evaluate the recurrence through memoized recursion with dependency guards.
contract.complexity: O(n) time and O(n) words for the primary; O(n) memo entries for the recursive reference.
contract.error_precedence: Validate non-null input, parseable length 1..2, exact length 1, signed integer, and index range before recurrence evaluation.
